emails.subject: delgado-housing-team@ — group membership confirmed
emails.body:
Hi Amara,

Quick admin note — IT finished setting up the delgado-housing-team@eastsidelegalaid.org distribution list you asked for. Current members (5):

  • Amara Singh (you) — Lead Housing Attorney
  • Kofi Mensah — Tenant Advocate
  • Hannah Brooks — Paralegal, docketing and filings (not in today's strategy conference)
  • Jordan Pike — Law Student Clerk
  • Daniel Okafor (me) — Managing Attorney

Anything sent to that address will go to all five of us. Let me know if you want to add or remove anyone.

— Daniel

emails.subject: Delgado housing case — escrow and hearing confirmation
emails.body:
Hi Amara,

Confirming the $4,200 rent escrow figure for the Delgado housing case, and the Harbor County Housing Court hearing is holding for May 14. After this morning's strategy conference, send me the plan for the answer, counterclaim, and exhibits so I can reflect it in the weekly case review.

Thanks,
Daniel

emails.subject: Loop me in on counterclaim filing deadlines
emails.body:
Hey Amara,

Once you and Kofi settle the filing deadlines for the answer and counterclaim in the Delgado housing case, can you loop me in? I want to get them on the docketing calendar and line up the filing packet so nothing collides with the other May housing court dates I'm tracking.

No rush — happy to coordinate after your strategy conference this week.

— Hannah

emails.subject: Reminder: laptop refresh window opens May 5
emails.body:
Hi Amara,

Your laptop is approaching its 3-year refresh window. You can self-schedule a swap any time between May 5 and June 30 via the IT portal.
